description.mn: Al Haramain Amber Oud Carbon Edition: Хүйс харгалзахгүй модлог үнэр (EDP). Эхний ноот: бергамот, лаванда, розмарин; зүрхний ноот: далайн ноот, герань, мэргэн өвс; суурь ноот: хөвд, хуш мод, ветивер, хув.
description.en: Amber Oud Carbon Edition by Al Haramain Perfumes is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Amber Oud Carbon Edition was launched in 2022. Top notes are Bergamot, Lavender and Rosemary; middle notes are Sea Notes, Geranium and Sage; base notes are Moss, Cedar, Vetiver and Amber.
